name: open-agent-lab
description: Tools from the open-agent-lab: catch silent agent regressions, undo what an agent changed, enforce one permission policy, and measure run-to-run consistency.

plugins.name: nerf-watch
plugins.description: Find out when your coding agent quietly got worse or more expensive. Adds /nerf-watch:check, /nerf-watch:share and /nerf-watch:phantom (edits the agent claimed but never made).

plugins.name: snap-back
plugins.description: Undo for coding agents: snapshots before each prompt and around every file-changing tool call. Adds /snap-back:undo, /snap-back:list and /snap-back:status.

plugins.name: agent-fence
plugins.description: One permission policy for coding agents, enforced by a PreToolUse hook. Adds /agent-fence:explain and /agent-fence:log.

plugins.name: rerun-bench
plugins.description: Run the same coding tasks N times per agent and measure pass^k, flip rate and cost spread. Adds /rerun-bench:run-mock and /rerun-bench:report.
